selected.title: Claude Cookbooks adds a notebook for tracing SDK requests, tools and API spans with OpenTelemetry
selected.summary: Anthropic added observability/opentelemetry_tracing.ipynb to its MIT-licensed Claude Cookbooks on October 14. The notebook shows SDK spans for Messages, streaming and tools and how traceparent can join separate API spans with an organization-admin destination. This is a new tutorial artifact, not a newly released tracing feature.
selected.availability: Open repository notebook; Python 3.11+, Anthropic Python SDK >=1.14.0, OpenTelemetry packages and Claude API credentials for live calls. Managed Agents section needs beta access and creates cloud resources; API span destination requires organization admin.
selected.practical_use: Pin the commit, register an OpenTelemetry provider, run the Messages example with an authorized API key, inspect SDK spans first and add API-side destination only with administrator access; retain metadata-only content mode by default.

editorial_review.context: repositories / builder / daily; new Claude Cookbooks OpenTelemetry notebook in October 14 commit
editorial_review.viewer_question: What does Anthropic's new Claude tracing cookbook help a builder inspect, and what setup is needed?
editorial_review.prerequisites: Python 3.11+, Claude API key, notebook dependencies; org-admin access only for API-side destination and Managed Agents beta access only for its optional section.
editorial_review.central_task: Trace one Claude Messages API request and inspect SDK spans, then understand the separate admin step needed to join API spans.
editorial_review.new_capability: A new versioned, public cookbook artifact now demonstrates the SDK-to-API trace flow, including tools and optional Managed Agents.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: 2026-10-12-mcp-reference-servers reviews MCP educational packages, not tracing Claude API calls. No archived Claude OpenTelemetry cookbook episode.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: A builder can pin the notebook, run a minimal authorized request and find where a request spent time before opting into organization-wide API tracing.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Exact commit, notebook, README/license and beta documentation inspected; no Claude API call or backend observed by this channel.
editorial_review.alternatives: Gemini Argon API access and Codex maintenance are separately queued for distinct playlists; OmO has no verified recent release and the architecture paper is research-only.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: The October 14 added artifact is practical, timely and clearly different from prior repository coverage. Describe the notebook as new while keeping the tracing feature's beta maturity distinct.
editorial_review.search_query: Claude Cookbooks OpenTelemetry tracing notebook for Claude API and agent tools
editorial_review.useful_example: Inspect one messages.create SDK span with metadata_only and its traceparent; optional API span join needs a Console destination.
editorial_review.availability_limitation: No live test; API key/billing for the example, org admin for API destination, Managed Agents beta for section 6, and span schema may change.
editorial_review.accept_reject_rationale: Accepted as an artifact review in the repository playlist, not a generic Anthropic model headline or an untested performance claim.
editorial_review.final_verdict: The viewer learns that the October 14 change is a new notebook, can start from an SDK trace, and understands that API spans, beta Managed Agents and content export need different permissions. This is distinct from the October 12 MCP package review.
editorial_review.metadata_review: The search query, title, description and script all identify the Claude Cookbooks artifact and tracing task. Beta status, MIT license, exact setup, no-live-test boundary and admin-only API span configuration agree.
